extension.description:
Testing only - this add-on may break your system - DON'T INSTALL!
This is a private add-on for Bossanova808's own Kodi systems only. It switches on personal, household-specific behaviour in Bossanova808's skins (custom menus, profile handling and more) that will not make sense - and may not work - anywhere else.
If you have installed it by accident, please uninstall it.
extension.news: v1.0.0 - Initial release - marks a Kodi install as one of Bossanova808's own, so the Bossanova808 skins enable their household-specific behaviour

extension.summary: Automatically forces software decoding for rotated or otherwise broken video played from chosen paths, restoring hardware decoding afterwards.
extension.description:
CoreELEC's amcodec hardware decoder mishandles some videos: rotated phone/camera clips usually play stretched (occasionally with the wrong orientation), and some old MJPEG AVI clips won't play at all.
Limp detects affected files and forces software decoding just for those, restoring hardware decoding afterwards. Scope it to specific paths, or apply everywhere.
extension.news: v1.0.0 - Detects and forces software decoding for video that trips up Amlogic's amcodec hardware decoder - files with a rotation tag, and MJPEG-in-AVI clips that hang on hardware decode entirely - Scope it to specific paths, or apply everywhere - Restores hardware decoding once affected playback ends

extension.summary: Patch Kodi skins for OzWeather Radar Support.
extension.description: Supports: Estuary (& Plextuary), Estouchy, Confluence, A Confluence Zeitgeist, Xonfluence, OSMC, Amber, Aeon (Nox Silvo and Tajo) - This addon attempts to patch Kodi skins for OzWeather radar support. - By default, will auto-patch your skin every time a new version of the skin arrives. - Skin folder **must be writeable!** - Creates a backup of the original skin files first and this addon can also restore those if need be). - By default, patches only the actual weather page. - For Estuary & Confluence, this also patches your VideoFullScreen file for weather during playback when video info is displayed.
extension.news:
v0.5.10 - Fix malformed default background opacity value - Fix restore not sticking - could be silently undone by the next auto-patch run - Fix crash if OzWeather isn't installed/enabled when patching - Manually running the patcher on a bossanova808 skin no longer touches its files (matches auto-patch behaviour) - Escape user-configured colours before writing them into skin XML - Tighten skin detection & make the auto-patch delay respond promptly to Kodi shutting down
v0.5.9 - Improve logging and threading
